# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 6 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Borders and rings — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 41 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 12 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Sizing — 14 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text-primary, #20252b);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--text-primary, #ecede9);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #20252b;
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-primary` | #20252b | #ecede9 | Body and headings on bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-subtle. 7:1 or better in both themes. |
| `--text-secondary` | #444c56 | #b9bec5 | Supporting copy on bg-surface, bg-canvas, bg-inset and bg-selected. |
| `--text-tertiary` | #636b75 | #8f96a0 | Metadata, captions, mono labels on bg-surface, bg-canvas, bg-subtle and bg-selected. |
| `--text-inverse` | #ffffff | #171a1d | Glyph or text on a solid stage fill (verified cells, stamps). |
| `--text-link` | #2458e8 | #7e9cff | Inline links on bg-surface and bg-canvas. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-disabled` | #a4aab2 | #565d66 |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 40px/40px "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-t-display); letter-spacing: -0.035em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `t-display` | `.t-display`, `--text-t-display` | 40px / 40px, letter-spacing -0.035em | 600 | `sans` | Page statement. One per screen. |
| `t-h1` | `.t-h1`, `--text-t-h1` | 28px / 32px, letter-spacing -0.025em | 600 | `sans` | Lesson and card titles. |
| `t-h2` | `.t-h2`, `--text-t-h2` | 20px / 24px, letter-spacing -0.018em | 600 | `sans` | Section titles. |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Geist-Variable.woff2` and `fonts/GeistMono-Variable.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Geist-Variable.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Geist-Variable.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geist | `fonts/Geist-Variable.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read fonts/Geist-Variable.woff2` | `var(--font-sans)` | `geist` |
| Geist Mono | `fonts/GeistMono-Variable.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read fonts/GeistMono-Variable.woff2` | `var(--font-mono)` | `geist-mono` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 0;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-0);
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-0` | 0 | No gap. |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Half-step. Icon to label, tag padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Base unit. Control inner gaps. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Compact padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Inside cards. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Row padding. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card-grid gap, layout gutter. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Between related blocks. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Between page sections. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Large block gap. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Page margins on wide screens. |
| `--space-24` | 96px | Hero spacing. |
